name: sf-delivery-brief
description: Turns a Jira ticket into a one-minute Salesforce solution brief grounded in your real org: reuse-first impact analysis (DX0), a Salesforce Docs check only when it matters, and 2-3 options with a recommendation. Agents accelerate. Humans decide.
